accountDeletion.confirmBody: Your account, name, IBAN, comments and uploaded receipts will be removed. Shared debts and payments remain under “Deleted account”; this member cannot be claimed again. Contact support before deleting if shared descriptions contain your personal information. This cannot be undone.
accountDeletion.retryBody: Once deletion starts, household access is removed. Retry to finish cleaning up files. If the problem continues, contact caludebabaq@gmail.com.

safety.reportHint: Only the app operator reviews your report. Support: caludebabaq@gmail.com.
safety.blockHint: Blocking hides their comments and stops push/email alerts initiated by that person. Shared debts, tasks and system reminders remain visible.
safety.error: The action could not finish. Please retry.
safety.termsBody: Roomly tracks shared expenses, lists and tasks; it does not transfer money. Household members can view and manage shared records, including personal lists. Only share content you have the right to share. Harassment, threats, hate speech, sexual content, fraud, spam and unauthorized disclosure of private information are prohibited. Report content or users and block users under People → Safety and support. Account deletion removes linked personal data while preserving shared balances. Read the full terms using the link below. Version: October 23, 2026.
safety.privacyNotice: Accepting the terms is not blanket consent to all data processing. See Privacy for data handling and deletion details.
